'''Keldooine''' was a minor [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Keldooine system/Legends|Keldooine system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the planets of [[Kwenn/Legends|Kwenn]] and [[Nar Bo Sholla]]. During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Keldooine served as a customs stop for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that left Hutt [[Realspace/Legends|Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keldooine was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square R-10.<ref name="TEA" />
